name: Hachirō Mase
role: Retired Frame fitter, bucket number four, the Bathhouse
designNotes:
Created 2026-09-30 from this regular's cast entry in canon/scenes/rest--bathhouse.json. Everything about who they are and what they want is that entry's own; only the physical description and the ancestry are new.

ANCESTRY, chosen by Claude under Ingram's 2026-09-30 goal (any ancestry is allowed): Dwarf ('Short, squat, and hardy, dwarves take great pride in their traditions and are known as the best and fairest crafters in the galaxy.' -- ancestry-catalogue.json): one of Golarion's own peoples, so no disguise is needed.

PORTRAIT: An old bald dwarf with a great white moustache, a folded towel on his head and his bucket under one arm, eyes screwed shut in a happy grin.

VOICE NOTES: forced catchphrases in this regular's tics and sample lines were rewritten as habits and manner (tools/art-review/ledger.json has each before and after).

Her or his real statblock is still a placeholder in the scene file (Proposed: level 1, an old working adult, non-combat. Made with Ingram once the NPC generator exists.); not carried here.
status: drafted 2026-09-30 from the haunt's cast entry; portrait chosen the same day

facts.text: new pilots turn on the heel, and the heel is where a Frame's foot cracks. Turn on the ball of the foot, he says, and the fitters will love you.
